meta.title: My Profile | PADEL2GO
meta.description: Manage your Padel2Go profile, view your rewards and your skill level.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: You can permanently delete your account right here (Art. 17 GDPR). Booking and invoice data subject to statutory retention periods is kept in anonymised form.
delete.confirmBody:
This action cannot be undone.

Your profile, points and balance will be permanently deleted. Completed bookings and receipts are retained in anonymised form for tax-law reasons (§ 147 AO).
delete.successBody: Your account and personal data have been deleted.
delete.error: Deletion failed – please try again or contact us.

pushMarketing.title: Marketing push notifications
pushMarketing.description: Receive news, promotions and offers as push notifications (optional). Booking and order notifications are not affected.

dataExport.title: Data export
dataExport.description: Download a copy of the data we store about you as JSON (Art. 15/20 GDPR).

return.dialogBody: You can withdraw from your purchase within 14 days of receipt. Return shipping is free for you — after you report it, we'll email you all the details. See the <1>withdrawal policy</1> for details.
